notes: ACCESS: plain direct fetch of https://www.heals.com/ (Shopify storefront) - no blocking of any kind, no proxy needed; robots.txt carries no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai directive. TREE: taken from the desktop mega-menu in the homepage header HTML (identical on every page). Top-level nav is By Room / Sofas / Furniture / Lighting / Accessories / Soft Furnishings / Gifts / Brands / Clearance & Offers; furniture lives in the 'Sofas' and 'Furniture' mega-menus plus furniture nodes scattered through 'By Room' (Bedroom -> Bedroom Furniture/Beds; Kitchen -> Barstools; Garden -> outdoor furniture; Bathroom -> Bathroom Wall Cabinets). Collection pages carry no on-page subcategory strip, so the room landing pages /pages/bedroom, /pages/living-room and /pages/garden and the collections sitemap were also mined; that is where Wardrobes, Chest of Drawers, Dressing Tables, Console Tables and the garden bench/stool nodes come from. QTY METHOD: this site publishes NO product-count header and NO count in any embedded JSON - the listing pages ('N products'/'Showing 1-N of M') were checked on three collections and there is nothing to read, and there is no Algolia/Searchspring/Boost/Constructor layer. So every qty is a FULL ENUMERATION, done two independent ways and cross-checked: (a) walking every paginated listing page /collections/<h>?page=N to the last page number in the pagination widget and collecting unique /products/<handle> links, and (b) paging /collections/<h>/products.json?limit=250 to exhaustion and collecting unique product handles. The two methods agreed EXACTLY on 56 of 62 collections. The 6 apparent mismatches were fully explained, not guessed: three header-promo product links ('arc-dining-chair', 'forum-3-seater-sofa', 'heals-e-gift-card') are injected into the header of every page, so they were stripped from the HTML walk - for the four collections where two of those products are genuine members (sofas, 3-seater-sofas, chairs, dining-chairs) the products.json figure is the correct one and is what is reported; the other two (sofas, loveseats) were HTTP-500 timeouts on the first HTML walk and matched on retry. Shopify's /collections.json 'products_count' aggregate was NOT used anywhere - the prior Home-Decor pass proved it inflated on this exact store. Sanity checks: every number differs by category, none is a round display cap, every page h1 was captured and matches the node it was fetched for, and containment between every parent and its children was computed product-by-product. HIERARCHY: parents with real children are grouping rows (Sofas, Chairs, Storage, Home Office, Bedroom Furniture, Outdoor Furniture). Dining/Coffee/Side Tables and Outdoor Tables are kept as leaves because their only nav children are material or shape filter views (Glass/Wooden/Marble coffee tables, Rectangular/Round dining tables, wooden/metal garden furniture) which the brief bans as categories. The 'Sofa Sizes' nodes (2/3/4 Seater) ARE kept as leaves: measured against the Sofas umbrella the sofa TYPE nodes alone cover only 110/246 while type+size together cover 241/246, and the two sets overlap on only 12 products - so they are complementary, not a duplicate view. Two deliberate documented overlaps remain because the site nav lists both nodes as siblings: Chaise Sofas (37) is a strict subset of Corner Sofas (70), and Lounge Chairs (72) is a strict subset of Armchairs (102). Armchairs is listed by the site under both 'Sofa Types' and 'Chairs' and is emitted once, under Chairs. 'Shelving Units' and 'Bookshelves' are two nav labels on one collection URL and are emitted once. EXCLUDED and why: Mattresses (/pages/mattresses - bedding, not furniture, per the brief) and the divans/vispring mattress-brand collections; Bathroom Storage (42) - product_type audit shows Cabinets 9 + Bathroom Storage 9 + Boxes 6 + Side Tables 5 + Towel Rails 4 + Wall Hooks 2 + Bathroom Accessories 2 + Coat Stands 1, i.e. mostly standalone storage goods and bathroom accessories, and its 7 genuine cabinets are separately capturable as Bathroom Wall Cabinets, which IS included; Towel Rails, Bathroom Accessories, Face & Body; Baskets & Boxes (standalone storage, out of scope here); all upholstery-material sofa collections (leather/fabric/velvet) and all material/shape/style table and sofa SEO collections (oak-, walnut-, marble-, glass-, small-, mid-century-, scandi-, traditional-) as filter pages; 'Collections' blocks (Togo by Ligne Roset, Outline by Muuto, Eames Lounge Chair, Forum by Case), all brand landing collections, /pages/bespoke-dining, Clearance & Offers and every gift/price node; Accent Chairs (/collections/accent-chairs exists but is empty - 0 products, confirmed both ways); Desk Chairs and Swivel Chairs (desk-chairs is byte-identical to Office Chairs, swivel-chairs holds 1 product already in Chairs, neither is in the nav); Bed Headboards, Bed Frames, Storage Beds (all strict subsets of the Beds node, none in the nav); Living Room Furniture / Dining Room Furniture / Living Room Tables (SEO umbrella roll-ups above nodes already emitted); and all lighting, mirrors, wall art, rugs, bedding, throws, cushions, tableware, glassware, kitchenware, home fragrance, decor and accessory nodes.
